description: Whether a completed reply goes to the summarizer instead of being spoken in full (spec #100 slice 2.5, ticket #160): only with Spoken Summaries on (off by default, they cost tokens) and a reply of at least 350 Characters (extended grapheme clusters, counted on the reply as it is, untrimmed). The summarizer process, its timeout and the generation counter that drops a late summary stay with the platform.
function: AppState.wantsSummary(of:speakSummaries:) — input {reply, speakSummaries} with reply a text descriptor, expected a bool
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.12, v2.14; Tests/PowerUpTests/SpeechFixtureTests.swift testSummaryThresholdTable plays it through AppState.wantsSummary(of:speakSummaries:). Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/speech.rs summary_threshold_cases runs speech::wants_summary.
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation and NaturalLanguage (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 67659a4

cases.name: summaries off never summarize
cases.reason: Spoken Summaries are off by default because they cost tokens (HK-169).

cases.name: 349 Characters is spoken in full
cases.reason: A reply under 350 Characters is faster to speak than to summarize (HK-169).

cases.name: 351 Characters is summarized
cases.reason: A reply over the threshold is summarized (HK-169).

cases.name: 349 emoji Characters is spoken in full
cases.reason: The threshold counts Characters, not scalars or UTF-16 units: 349 ZWJ families are far more than 350 scalars (HK-173).

cases.name: 350 emoji Characters is summarized
cases.reason: 350 Characters reach the threshold whatever they are made of (HK-173).

cases.name: 349 decomposed accents is spoken in full
cases.reason: A letter with its combining accent counts once (HK-173).

cases.name: 349 CJK Characters is spoken in full
cases.reason: CJK text is counted in Characters, not bytes (HK-173).

cases.name: empty with summaries on
cases.reason: An empty reply never reaches the summarizer (HK-169).

cases.name: whitespace counts toward the threshold
cases.reason: The reply is counted as it is, untrimmed (HK-169).
